items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: Brother Bowling's number and stuff like that, you know.

ctx.x: Did you hear much music in the churches? Did you belong to a church in those days? Did you ever go to the churches? Did you hear any of the singing there? What kind of music they had there?
Well, they had a lot of singing in the churches at that time. Brother Bowling's number and stuff like that, you know.
Which church did you go to? Were you Catholic or Protestant or Baptist?
